fusions.name: Worry the Wound
fusions.desc: Worries a hooked link into the target for 8 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Casts a leash at the first enemy it meets, up to 7 tiles away, and runs you down it to the target for 14 damage.

fusions.name: Lifeline
fusions.desc: Throws a lifeline to the ally who needs it most: they regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hound at Heel
fusions.desc: A leashed hound fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
